**Triage: routing only — `domain:skills`. ⛔ No grading, no priority, no `pm:*` state, and that is deliberate.**

SKILL.md: **skills 车道 finding 由该席自分诊,全仓轮跳过.** ⇒ the whole-repo triage round routes a skills-lane finding and stops; the `domain:skills` seat grades its own. `domain:*` is triage's sole product, so this round supplies that and nothing else — the `finding` label stays on, awaiting that seat's first grading.

### Landing surface

`skills/objectstack-data` — the **published** skills catalog, governed, and shipped to customers.

⚠️ **Raised in answer to the maintainer's own question** on #16934 — 「ats 为什么会搞错,是我们的 skills 或者文档没写清楚吗?」 — and the answer measured here is *yes*: the published skill never says what `single` posture means for the organization count, so an AI app author reading it (plus the code's exemption list) lands on **「stay `single`, seed one `sys_organization` per tenant, bring your own RLS wall」**. The sentence forbidding that shape lives only in `content/docs/deployment/tenancy-modes.mdx` and ADR-0105, **neither linked from the skill**.

⭐ The filer classes it (c) — a seed shape the runtime accepts and then silently mis-serves — and (b) by omission. ⇒ this is the highest-leverage shape in the taxonomy: a published skill is read by every AI author, and a tenancy wall is not a surface where silent mis-service is recoverable.

⛔ Triage does not grade it, but it is named in this round's report so the skills seat sees it against a maintainer question that is already open.

Rationale: the published skill is the one text guaranteed to be in an AI author's context, and the shape it induces (tenants as `sys_organization` rows under `single`, hand-rolled RLS, walls 「stood up later」) is the shape `tenancy-modes.mdx:48` forbids by name — the maintainer's own #16934 question measured the cost on ats. Not p1: the write side refuses (#8844) so nothing is silently corrupted; the loss is a wrong design and a wrong bug report. Landing (the filer's shape, accepted as this seat's reading — veto window in the round report): one contract sentence in `rules/security.md` 「## Multi-tenancy」 — `single` = the bootstrapped Default Organization and nothing else; tenants-as-organizations ⇒ a walled posture declared on the deployment, open-core since #16215 + #16719 — a ⛔ line under `SKILL.md` §「Seed Data & Fixtures」 that `sys_organization` is platform-bootstrapped and never seeded, the Sources line extended to ADR-0093 / ADR-0105 §「Today's two postures」 / `content/docs/deployment/tenancy-modes.mdx`, and `data-hooks.md:623` re-read against ADR-0132. Reader of each line: an AI author choosing between `tenancy` on an object and a posture on the deployment. ⛔ Not: `tenancy-modes.mdx` (already states the contract), the runtime (boot-time count is #17010). Value gate (#13597): ① yes — the reader lands on a forbidden shape today; ② net +5–6 lines across three files, paid by tightening the two sentences that point the other way; ③ construct = the posture ↔ organization-count contract. Governed (`skills/**`) ⇒ draft at the human terminal; build and review at the contract-review tier (published skill, tier policy in force). Hot file: `rules/security.md` is also #17359's deliverable-2 site (+3 lines after :33, blocked on #17189) — different region (:153–180), different defect ⇒ fold gate ① fails, region-level parallel is allowed, no serial needed.
